intro.text: A skaa of the Final Empire, known for being extremely nervous and paranoid.

items.text: Knew Kelsier and Dockson, and may have worked with them. When Kelsier met Vin, her wariness reminded him of Vent; Dockson said she wasn't that bad, and the two laughed about Vent's jumpiness, speaking of him in the past tense.
